title: Add changeset for filter operators patch
body:
Adds a patch changeset for the filter operators fix merged in #867 (`$contains`, `$notContains`, `$startsWith`, `$endsWith`, `$between`, `$null` normalization in spec and memory driver).

Both `@objectstack/spec` and `@objectstack/driver-memory` are bumped as patch. Fixed versioning propagates to all 43 packages.
